ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and remind the driver that NS-1(iii) requires continuous presence within the pickup radius for MORE than 3 minutes after the "I'm Here" tap before a no-show fee can attach.
ruling.reasoning: This is a driver-cancelled no-show fee dispute, so NS-0 routes it to NS-1/NS-2: the driver cancelled (F4) and asserted the rider no-showed (F12, F10) [NS-0]. The trace settles the first two NS-1 elements: arrival was confirmed by a driver tap at 13:02:35, i.e. driver_tap (F6), and at that instant the driver was 39 m from the pickup, within the 200 m radius (F6, F1) [NS-1]. The third element fails. NS-1(iii) requires continuous presence at the pickup for MORE than 3 minutes after the arrival confirmation (the default threshold of 180 s, exceeded, i.e. ≥ 3:01) [NS-1]. The record shows only 2 min 55 s (175 s) inside the radius after the 13:02:35 tap before the 13:05:30 cancellation (F6). The longer presence figures are earlier and do not help: the platform arrival record at 13:01:00 plus 4 min 30 s runs to the cancellation (F2, F5), and the stationary spell of 3 min 15 s runs 13:02:15–13:05:30 (F3). Both of these windows start BEFORE the arrival confirmation at 13:02:35, and NS-1(iii) expressly excludes time spent near the pickup before the tap and requires presence until the cancellation [NS-1]. The driver's chat "More than 3 min already" at 13:05 (F10) and his written statement of waiting more than 3 minutes (F12) are statements, not records, and are contradicted by the measured post-tap wait (F6) [NS-1]. Because NS-1(iii) is not satisfied, NS-1 as a whole fails, and NS-2 gives the rider a full refund of the $6.61 cancellation fee (F4, F7) [NS-2]. The NS-2 add-on flag does not apply: the trace shows the driver was genuinely within 39 m of the pickup at the moment of the tap, so there was no fake arrival confirmation — no account action is warranted on these facts [NS-2]. The amount is the cancellation fee stated in the timeline and fare records: $6.61 (F4, F7), matching the allowed outcome for this case; no mileage formula is involved because this is a fee dispute, not a route deviation [NS-2]. The rider's complaint that the fee was charged for nothing is thus upheld only on the threshold failure, not on any finding that the driver acted fraudulently. The rider's own contact a minute after the cancellation (complaint) is irrelevant to NS-1(iii), which looks only at the driver's post-tap wait; it is noted to explain why no further charge may stand [NS-2]. Refund is issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7; the request is timely at case level [NS-7].
